citizen_flow.description: Report waste issues with photo/location, request doorstep pickup, track status live, and earn eco reward points.
key_features: Quick Action Hero Banner with Geolocation detector
Report Waste / Illegal Dump modal with photo URL, severity tag, location pin
Schedule Special Doorstep Bulk Waste Pickup
My Complaints list with live stage progress bar (Reported -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Cleaned)
Reward Points counter & Green Badges redeem system

worker_flow.description: Field worker portal to view route tasks, start task, update status with resolution proof, and mark job completed.
key_features: Daily Task Queue sorted by priority & proximity ETA
Task Map card with turn-by-turn simulation & location coordinates
Start Job / Update Status toggle with timer & resolution note submission

admin_flow.description: Municipal command center to monitor civic complaint statistics, assign workers, oversee hotspots on dynamic map, and auto-dispatch.
key_features: 4 KPI Metric Cards (Total Complaints, Pending, In Progress, Cleaned Today, High Risk)
Interactive Smart City Hotspot Map with status-coded markers (Red=Pending, Blue=In Progress, Green=Cleaned)
Worker Assignment Matrix (assign unassigned reports to active field workers)
Filters by Ward, Category, Severity & Date
Analytics charts powered by Recharts (Daily Resolution Rate, Category Breakdown)

interactive_map_guidelines.implementation: Use a Leaflet / Canvas / SVG-based interactive city map component with real browser navigator.geolocation coordinate fetching fallback.
interactive_map_guidelines.geolocation: Include a 'Detect My Live Location' button that populates lat/lng coordinates and street address in complaint & pickup forms.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, status badges, and table rows MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='role-switch-worker-btn', data-testid='submit-complaint-btn', data-testid='assign-worker-select').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: All text elements must satisfy AA contrast ratios against their respective light/dark backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep single link app architecture with a persistent top bar navigation allowing seamless Role Switcher (Citizen | Sanitation Worker | Municipal Admin).
2. Ensure state changes (e.g., Citizen reports waste -> Admin assigns Worker -> Worker completes task) immediately reflect across all roles via API / React state sync.
3. Implement full MongoDB backend endpoints for users, complaints, pickup requests, workers, and metrics.
4. Pre-seed demo data so the dashboard is immediately vibrant with real-looking civic issues, mapped hotspots, assigned tasks, and reward points.
5. Use Sonner toasts for action feedback (e.g., 'Complaint Submitted Successfully!', 'Worker Assigned', 'Task Marked Complete').
